CustomField.description: This field will calculate the margin due to FPC not taking into account the lender doc fee.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) < DATE(2012,10,17) , Lender_Account__c = "0018000000nfYbl"), ACTUAL_AMT_COLLECTED__c * (Actual_Points_Earned__c/100), ACTUAL_AMT_OFFERED__c * (Actual_Points_Earned__c/100))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field will calculate the margin due to FPC not taking into account the lender doc fee.
CustomField.label: Actual FPC Margin w/o Doc Fee
